comments.body:
Same situation as #22683: the workflows here have been sitting in `action_required` since 14 August and never ran, so this PR shows no checks rather than green ones. If a maintainer can press "Approve and run workflows" on either of them it should unblock the rest.

Local run against current `main` — `embedding_utils.py` has not been touched upstream since I opened this:

```
$ pytest tests/indices/query/test_embedding_utils.py -q
3 passed
```

With only the change to `embedding_utils.py` reverted:

```
1 failed, 2 passed
```

The one-line summary: `get_top_k_embeddings_learner`-style MMR selection compared each candidate against the most recently selected result only, so a near-duplicate stopped looking redundant as soon as one unrelated result was picked in between, and came back into the ranking — the single thing MMR exists to prevent. It now penalizes against every already-selected result.
